stances.summary: Criticizes Trump diplomacy, warns Iran exploiting negotiations for sanctions relief
stances.quote: It’s crystal clear that there is no current path to get Iran to give up its nuclear program. They are toying with Trump and his diplomatic ingenus. They know they can get complete sanctions relief and all their frozen money without a single nuclear concession.

stances.summary: Opposes Iran nuclear deal lacking concessions, calls it disaster
stances.quote:
I will support a bad deal to end this war. Because we need to cut Trump’s hemorrhaging losses now. 

But the supposed deal on the table pays Iran $100 billion to open the Strait. And no concessions on their nuclear program. 

What an unmitigated disaster.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of gaslighting about Iran negotiations status
stances.quote:
A “possible” deal to start talking about a “possible” deal. 

Trump has been gaslighting us all along about the state of Iran negotiations. I will be on the Senate floor to talk about this later in the week.

stances.summary: Opposes Trump's Saudi nuclear deal, warns against Iran conflict escalation
stances.quote: Let me explain to you why the agreement Trump just announced with Saudi Arabia - giving them the ability to start a full nuclear program - makes peace with Iran much less likely. It's just more foreign policy malpractice.

stances.summary: Warns that military strikes cannot eliminate Iran's missile capability
stances.quote:
No matter how many strikes we launch, it cannot erase the fact the Iran has figured out how to hide its missiles and drones, and quickly recover from the damage we do.

After 145 days of war, the majority of Iran’s missiles sites on the Strait are operational.

A forever war.

stances.summary: Calls Trump's Iran war a failure, demands immediate end
stances.quote:
146 days into Trump’s war with Iran, he has achieved ZERO of his goals.

I went to the Senate floor today to break down the list of Trump’s major failures - and why this war needs to end now.

1/🧵

stances.summary: Criticizes failure to eliminate Iran's nuclear capability
stances.quote:
4/FAILURE 3: Eliminating Iran’s nuclear threat.

Another spectacular failure. Iran still has its enriched uranium. And the scientific knowledge it gained after Trump abandoned the nuclear deal. No strike can undo that - now or ever.

stances.summary: Opposes continued war funding, calls conflict out of control
stances.quote:
5/Trump has achieved nothing. His ceasefire has fallen apart. The conflict is spinning out of control. There’s no viable path forward - but Trump wants YOU to write another check to fund this disaster.

Congress should do its job and end this war before more lives are lost.

stances.summary: Calls Trump's war policy biggest foreign policy disaster since Iraq
stances.quote: It’s impossible to overhype how disastrous this war has been. It was unwinnable from the start. Trump’s hubris has led to the biggest foreign policy disaster since Iraq.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump corruption and incompetence, blames for inflation
stances.quote:
Our message is simple. 

Trump’s corruption and incompetence is losing the war - and as a result gas and food prices are skyrocketing. 

The November election a referendum to end the war.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump scheme selling White House war announcement access
stances.quote:
I went to the Senate floor today to ask a simple question.

Can any of my Republican colleagues defend the President's disgusting new scheme to sell early access to White House announcements about the war for $100,000 a month? 

Of course they can't.

stances.summary: Disputes Republican claims about limiting Trump's alleged slush fund
stances.quote:
This morning the Judiciary Committee is expected to approve Trump’s personal lawyer, Todd Blanche, for Attorney General. 

Republicans will claim they got a commitment to end Trump’s political payout slush fund. 

THEY DID NOT. Let me tell you why.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for shutting down grants to European information partners who criticize his allies
stances.quote: This week, I raised the alarm over how Trump has been shutting down grants to information partners in Europe who criticize his allies there. He is turning our taxpayer funded counter-propaganda operations into right wing propaganda.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of corruption by selling advance policy announcements for $100,000 monthly fee
stances.quote:
He doesn't care anymore. It's just non-stop, in-your-face corruption.

The latest? If you pay Trump $100,000 a month, he will give you advance White House announcements on economic and trade policy.

An insider trading subscription service.

People will go to jail for this.

The conditions in ICE detention centers are outrageous. Worms. Standing sewage water. Measles outbreaks. 

52 people have died so far. No American - no matter what your view is on immigration - should stand for this inhumanity.

stances.summary: Credits Nancy Wyman's role in preserving Affordable Care Act
stances.quote:
Nancy Wyman passed away this morning. Many in politics will remember her for her enormous, generous personality. And those red high heels.

1/ But she was so much more. I want to share a story that few know: how Nancy Wyman saved the Affordable Care Act.

stances.summary: Credits Nancy Wyman's role in preserving Affordable Care Act
stances.quote:
6/ CT's successful implementation of the ACA was a sign that the problem was NOT the ACA's design, but simply the federal website's faulty tech.

Wyman proved that a well run exchange would have huge demand. And her success gave space for the feds to fix the national website.

stances.summary: Credits Nancy Wyman's role in preserving Affordable Care Act
stances.quote:
7/ Eventually, 20M Americans got their health care from the ACA. And without Wyman's success in CT - while the national exchange was failing - the repeal campaign might have prevailed.

So it's not hyperbole to say Nancy Wyman helped save health care for 20M Americans.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's healthcare cuts as devastating to families
stances.quote: Great to be with @AnnieAndrewsMD in Charleston last night. As a pediatrician, she’s witnessed first hand what Trump’s devastating health care cuts have done to families. A great candidate!

stances.summary: Advocates for $25 minimum wage based on economic data
stances.quote: An important read. The data doesn’t lie - we need a $25 minimum wage.

stances.quote:
A key element of a common good capitalism is more employee ownership of companies. It raises productivity and profit (though the profit if more broadly distributed). 

Yesterday I visited Flow-Tech, an employee-owned company in South Windsor to learn about their success.

stances.summary: Demands crypto regulation to end Trump's corruption schemes
stances.quote: Trump’s entire fortune is now dependent on being able to continue his family’s crypto corruption schemes. The Senate cannot pass a bill regulating crypto that doesn’t end Trump’s corruption.

stances.quote: Dear taxpayer: the way they are lighting your money on fire - for a war of insane vanity - is reason enough to boot out of office anyone who is empowering this war mongering profligate.
